blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tropical Storm Queenie has slightly accelerated while moving west-northwestward over the Philippine Sea east of extreme northern Luzon, the state weather bureau reported on Friday. Based on the 11 a.m. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather bulletin, Queenie – located 860 kilometers east of Extreme Northern Luzon – has a speed of 25 kilometers per hour (kph). The tropical storm maintained its strength, carrying a maximum sustained wind speed of 75 kph near the center and gustiness of up to 90 kph. READ: Cyclone east of N.
